post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I performed reasonably well in the missions, especially in Mission 3 where I successfully infiltrated the castle as the lead. However, I could improve by making more strategic guesses as the Assassin. I should have guessed Merlin or Evil correctly.

player_observations.Bob: Bob was a solid player, consistently participating in the good team's missions without any major mishaps. He played it safe and successfully completed two out of three missions with the good team.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie did an excellent job of executing the evil team's plans, ensuring they completed all but one mission. However, his aggressive playing style put him at risk in Mission 4, where Bob's team failed the mission.
player_observations.Diana: Diana played an unobtrusive yet effective role as Merlin, guiding the good team throughout the game. Her strategic decisions and communication with the team helped them achieve their goals.
player_observations.Eve: Eve demonstrated a well-rounded playstyle, participating in multiple good team missions and making valuable contributions to their success. Her team's win was largely due to her teamwork and effective role-playing.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I played a safe game, sticking to known roles and strategies, and was fortunate to have good luck with the missions I led. However, I should have been more proactive in investigating other players' trust levels and possibly making more accusations.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played a suspicious game as the Assassin, but was well-hidden; her ability to pretend to be a loyal Good player allowed her to blend in effectively.
player_observations.Bob: As me, I didn't really observe anything to do with myself, but for now, I will just say that nothing stands out.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie was a skilled Evil player, successfully manipulating the team with his missions. However, he made a mistake by not taking a more aggressive approach against me, the Merlin, at any point in time; he let Diana and the Good team take the initiative too many times.
player_observations.Diana: Diana played an excellent Merlin role, effectively guiding the Good team through the missions and using her knowledge to outmaneuver the Evil team. Her ability to remain hidden and maintain the Good team's trust was impressive.
player_observations.Eve: Eve played a bit too cautiously as the Good player, especially given how early she found herself on many teams with me. However, her caution led to successful mission outcomes most of the time; this suggests that her caution was a good thing.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I struggled to maintain the illusion of being good, particularly on Mission 2 and 3 where my teammates successfully completed their tasks without raising suspicion. I also failed to eliminate a key member of the opposing team, which cost me dearly in Mission 5. Overall, my gameplay was too predictable.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played the assassin role extremely well, always choosing a good target and effectively influencing the elimination of key players. Her ability to blend in and avoid detection was impressive.
player_observations.Bob: Bob's conservative gameplay ultimately worked in his favor, as he avoided taking unnecessary risks and allowed his team to stay intact until Mission 4. He was a valuable member of the good team.
player_observations.Diana: As the Merlin, Diana played a crucial role in keeping my team's plans from being discovered. Her subtle hints to her teammates and well-placed accusations were effective in misdirecting my team's attention.
player_observations.Eve: Eve was a strong player on both the evil and good teams, often taking on leadership roles and contributing to the success of her team. Her ability to adapt to new situations and make effective decisions was notable.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I effectively led and guided my team of Good players to successfully complete some missions and ultimately win the game. I was able to remain hidden as Merlin without being incorrectly guessed as Assassin, and my teammates were able to trust and follow my mission plans.

player_observations.Alice: Alice surprisingly played as the Assassin but didn't execute her role effectively, failing to eliminate a key Good player before their missions could be completed.
player_observations.Bob: Bob remained steadfast as a loyal Good player, contributing to mission success and trusting his teammates to make the right decisions.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie performed his role as the Evil player well, attempting to hinder Good player progress and cause maximum damage to the team's morale. However, he failed to eliminate Merlin, thereby contributing to our ultimate victory.
player_observations.Diana: As my teammate, Diana demonstrated excellent communication skills, following my plans and making crucial decisions in the midst of chaos without arousing suspicion.
player_observations.Eve: Eve played a pivotal role as a Good player, contributing to mission success and helping to eliminate the Assassin. However, they were mistakenly picked as the Assassin at one point, which was fortunate for me and our mission outcomes.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I successfully worked with multiple leaders and teams to achieve victory, while also identifying the correct Merlin role at the end. However, I feel that I may have been overly cautious in my trust decisions during the mission phases, which sometimes led to unnecessary risks. Improving my ability to read the game and make timely decisions will be key to future success.

player_observations.Charlie: Charlie played a very deceptive game as an evil character, successfully convincing me of their loyalty multiple times, while also taking risks to gain power.
player_observations.Diana: Diana made excellent decisions as Merlin, skillfully revealing information to aid our team's progress without giving away her identity.
player_observations.Alice: Alice's actions as the Assassin were subtle and well-concealed until the final reveal, making her a difficult role to detect.
player_observations.Bob: Bob demonstrated consistent loyalty as a good character but made some questionable decisions that almost cost us the game in Mission 4.
